violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COLORED CREAM AT 44F IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR UPRIGHT SLIDING DOOR (8).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: RED BEANS PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Cannot Exceed 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is being used as a control was not cooked, served or discarded by the expiration time as indicated: RED BEAN BUN, COCONUT CREAM ROLL, CURRY BREAD, ONION ROLL, LEMON CREAM BREAD, CHICKEN VEGETABLE BREAD, CUSTARD BREAD, YOGURT BREAD, BACON TOMATO BREAD, EGG TART, CREAM CHEESE TART, WHITE BEAN MANJU.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours is used as the public health control (TPHC): 1) the food shall have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature or, 2) the food shall have an initial temperature of 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 3) the food shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 4) the food shall be cooked and served, served if ready to eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 5) the food if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit shall be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FROM SELF SERVICE RACKS AND DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TPHC PROCEDURES ARE PROPERLY FOLLOWED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED WITH FOODS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS IN BACK STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REORGANIZE CHEMICAL STORAGE SEPARATELY FROM FOODS, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. Shilla Bakery and Cafe (Inspection Date: 04/14/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED SELF APPLIED COMBAT ROACH BAITS BOX AND BAITS DISTRIBUTED THROUGHOUT THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE AND UTILIZE ONLY CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICES AT ESTABLISHMENT. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BAKING PRODUCTS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN STORAGE AREA NEAR WALK IN FREEZER AND BACK STORAGE AREAS
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. UTILIZE EXISTING APPROVED SHELVING EFFICIENTLY AND PROVIDE ADDITIONAL APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS IF NECESSARY TO ELEVATE FOOD ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counters: IN FRONT COFFEE BAR AND BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE SANITIZER BUCKETS WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION PREPARED FOR EACH WORK STATION FOR STORING WET WIPING CLOTHS. CHANGE SOLUTIONS AT LEAST EVERY 4 HOURS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: NON FOOD GRADE SPRAY BOTTLES USED TO STORE WATER FOR DOUGH.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE USE OF BOTTLES FOR FOOD PREPARATION AND PROVIDE NSF APPROVED, FOODS SAFE BOTTLES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION EQUIPMENT, SHELVING AND UNDER COUNTERS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
